stem: What directly powers ATP formation during oxidative phosphorylation?

options.label: A
options.text: Spontaneous ADP joining without a gradient

options.label: B
options.text: Direct phosphate transfer from NADH to ADP
options.misconception: NADH does not substrate-level phosphorylate ADP here.
options.explanation: NADH donates electrons; the proton current drives synthesis.

options.label: C
options.text: Hydrogen-ion flow through the F0-F1 complex
options.misconception: None; proton flux drives the synthase.
options.explanation: OpenStax: hydrogen-ion current powers ATP synthase phosphorylation of ADP.

context: Learning objective: chemiosmotic proton flow drives ATP synthase.
imageCaption: Cellular respiration: glycolysis -> pyruvate -> acetyl-CoA -> citric cycle carriers -> ETC/ATP synthase; O2 terminal acceptor; fermentation regenerates NAD+.
